title: In the Exact Opposite Direction
text: Looks like my fiancée is coming along with us. Ugh… She’s planning to hit on my Father again, isn’t she?
“Is Mel-chan coming too?”
“Yeah! Sakura-chan.”
“Oh, okay!”
“This is getting complicated…”
“Boo.”
“Elena… don’t even think about suggesting we run away now. Seriously…”
My father was scolding the Lazy Pig with an exasperated look on his face.
“Well, it looks like we’re setting off now.”
“I guess so. Sorry, Keel. It looks like the village’s revival will have to wait a little longer.”
“It’s okay, big bro! If it’s going to happen for sure, I can wait a little!”
“I see… Alright then, let’s head out to stop Ren and Itsuki!”
“Understood!”
“Let’s gooo!”

Sakura-chan responds cheerfully. That’s right—we’ve got the swift-footed Filolial-samas with us. By the way, the Filolial-samas are already on the move. If they use portals regularly, wouldn’t they be able to travel nonstop without a break? Ha! Come to think of it, we have to do a Class Up on the Filolial-samas!
“Father! If we don’t do a Class Up on them before we go, we’re in for a rough time ahead!”
“Now that you mention it, you’re right.”
“If we have Yuki-chan and the others, who were granted the wings of the Great Filolial-sama, we can perform a special Class Up.”
“If we do this for Melty-chan and the other Filolials who’ve recently joined us, we can expect their abilities to improve.”
“That’s right!”
“…But, based on a simple calculation, isn’t Class Upping 101 of them going to be quite a lot of work? It’ll probably take a while, too.”
“If we cut corners, we’ll mess things up!”
Precisely because we’re in a hurry, we mustn’t neglect our preparations for when the time comes.
“So… Your Majesty, are we going to head out after we’ve gone through the Class Up process?”
“Filolial-sama are rushing toward the town below the castle.”
“That swarm… The town’s going to be in a panic—”
It was quite memorable how my Father muttered that in a voice that sounded utterly exhausted.

And so… after completing the Class Up for my Finacée and Filolial-sama and the others, we set out! Well, there were various hiccups along the way—like my Rival throwing a tantrum, saying he was tired of flying and didn’t want to ride in the carriage—but we were making fairly good progress toward the country where the Spirit Tortoise was sealed.
“Um, based on Ren and Itsuki’s eyewitness accounts… it wouldn’t be surprising if we caught up with them by now.”

Here and there, we’d come across reports of people who looked like Ren or Itsuki. We were heading toward the Spirit Tortoise’s realm while following those leads. By the way, in *Emerald Online*, the Spirit Tortoise quest involves going through a series of tedious steps before defeating the Spirit Tortoise’s avatar—which secretly controls the country—to discover the location of the sealed statue. After all, to defeat the Spirit Tortoise itself, you first have to break the seal.
“So, Melty-chan, could you confirm the Queen’s stance again for me?”
“Yes. We issued warnings and evacuation notices to both Melromarc and Siltvelt regarding the Spirit Tortoise’s sealed kingdom, but it seems they didn’t heed our advice.”
“Based on my knowledge from the game, the quest’s lore states that the country’s upper echelons have been turned into the Spirit Tortoise’s puppets.”
“Whether that’s accurate or not… well, it’s a tough situation. Apparently, it’s a country with a tendency toward isolationism.”
“Honestly, I haven’t heard many good things about it.”
Just then, our Rival rode up alongside us in a carriage with an Assistant. His expression is tense. Did something happen?
“The atmosphere feels kind of tense.”
“Did the seal break?”
“I don’t think so. If that were the case, a blue hourglass would appear in our field of vision.”
“It must be because we’ve entered the Spirit Tortoise’s territory.”

“I see… Even if it hasn’t been revived, the Spirit Tortoise is still active, isn’t it? To put it in game terms, we’re supposed to complete the quest properly… though maybe not—stopping Ren and Itsuki is what really matters.”
“Exactly.”
“So, Motoyasu, do you know where that seal is?”
“In the game I knew, there was only one, but from what I heard later, there were apparently three.”

“So in the future, the other heroes besides me each used their game knowledge to break all three, which is why it was lifted… I guess. Anyway, unlike in the game, since there’s a final seal, Ren and Itsuki might be surprised. But if all the seals gather in one place, there might be some aftershocks or something.”
“Should we plan for evacuation and guidance in the meantime?”
“Yeah. Well, I think we’ll be able to catch Ren and Itsuki soon enough, so no need to worry too much—”
Just as Father was about to finish speaking, a sound like shattering glass rang out in both our ears. A blue hourglass appeared in our field of vision… and the number 8 appeared.
“No way… has the Spirit Tortoise’s seal already been broken!?”
“Huh?”
My Finacée, Keel, Sakura-chan, and everyone around us looked alarmed. I stared at the number on the hourglass and realized the situation was taking a turn for the worse.
“No… what does this number mean!?”
“What’s wrong, Motoyasu-kun? Don’t tell me…”

Sensing my intent, my Father’s face turned pale. It seems that because Ren and Itsuki had warned my Father and me not to break the Spirit Tortoise’s seal—and that they would stop us at all costs—they ended up breaking a different seal instead.
“Based on what I know of the future… this number signifies the Phoenix.”

—The Phoenix. In the world of the future—well, actually, only I here know this—it is the enemy that caused an unforgivable tragedy. Although Takt was the cause, the damage was immense. Among the victims was Filolial-sama herself.

I remember it well. The inferno so bright it could be mistaken for light. Those who were consumed by the flames and vanished. How my Father shed tears for everyone who had fallen in battle. How he was enraged at Takt, the one responsible.
…We absolutely must not let something like that happen again!

However, the land where the Phoenix is sealed lies in a direction completely opposite to that of the Spirit Tortoise. We should assume we were completely led astray by Ren or Itsuki. Either way, now that it has been revived, we’d better hurry there as soon as possible.
This was the beginning of an incident that would teach us what kind of beings the Four Spirits are and what precautions we must take to defeat them.
“We’ve been outmaneuvered…! But how did they get to the country where the Phoenix is sealed?”
“Perhaps Ren had obtained a portal in advance?”

Ren had been operating out of Zeltoble as his base. That means he was able to move freely for quite some time. His level was rising steadily, so we can’t rule out the possibility that he was already planning his future hunting grounds.

No… that’s it! I remember that in the first world, after Cal Mira Island, the country with the waves that Ren was assigned to was west of Melromarc. I believe it was the country located between Melromarc and the land where the Phoenix is sealed.

He’d probably already acquired it via a portal. After calming the waves, didn’t he plan to head straight to the Spirit Tortoise’s sealed realm, and then, after defeating the Spirit Tortoise, make preparations before challenging the Phoenix?
“That’s possible. He simply assumed we hadn’t taken the portal and went in for the kill—only to have that move turned against him!”
“The Phoenix is a monster far more powerful than the Spirit Tortoise.”

In terms of raw power alone, it should be stronger than the Spirit Tortoise. There are two types—one that flies high and one that flies low—and their combat styles differed as well. Moreover, they possess an extremely troublesome trait: if you don’t defeat both at the same time, one will explode and revive.

To prove just how strong it is, even though it’s weaker than I am now, all four Holy Heroes—who possess abilities nearly on par with mine—struggled against it when they were all together. Rin and Itsuki, who haven’t put the enhancement techniques into practice, don’t stand a chance—not even one in ten thousand. And that’s even if they’re both there, mind you.
“Motoyasu, if you and I—having mastered all the enhancement techniques—were to take on the Phoenix… could we win?”
“I believe we could win without any trouble.”

Back then, we were fighting using only the Four Holy Heroes’ enhancement techniques, and the four of us put up a good fight, so there’s definitely a good chance we could win. No, even if it’s just me alone… I’ll definitely… show you we can win. And if my Father joins us here, we’ll be as strong as a hundred men.

“However, we’ll need to be careful about our combat strategy. The Phoenix is a pair of monsters; if you take out one first, the remaining one will self-destruct, causing massive damage to the surrounding area, and then it will revive.”
“A ‘simultaneous defeat’ type? That sounds like it’ll be a tough fight… but who knows what’ll happen if Ren and Itsuki take on something like that with just a small group!”
“Exactly!”

It seems they managed to escape the Spirit Tortoise, but there’s a chance those two might not be able to escape the Phoenix. If the Phoenix kills either Ren or Itsuki, we’ll end up back in the loop. …I’ll do everything I can to prevent that, but it might be best to brace yourself just in case.
“Maybe making a clean break to survive is the way to go?”
“Boo!”
“What are you two talking about, Lars-chan and Elena?”
Running away now would be a disgrace to a hero. But as they say, a mercenary knows when to cut their losses. It certainly might be a difficult path.
Plus, my father hasn’t fully mastered Magic yet. He hasn’t learned our family’s secret technique, All Liberation Aura X. Once he masters that, this Motoyasu will be as strong as a hundred men.
“It’s a race against time. Let’s head to that country quickly.”
“Yes! Right now, let’s go to the nearest country so we can challenge the Phoenix as soon as possible.”
My Finacée offers her advice. If we sort out the portals I can use and the ones my Father can use…
“Would returning to Melromarc be the fastest route?”
“That was a complete waste of time, wasn’t it?”
“Yeah. Let’s at least take this portal here before heading back for now!”
“Yes, sir.”
And so, our preparations to challenge the Spirit Tortoise have completely come to nothing.
